patterns.note: Asymmetrical layout for main content blocks, often featuring a large text block on the left and ample whitespace or a content placeholder on the right.
Dominant use of a single sans-serif typeface with extreme variations in size and weight, from oversized, bold headings to small, light body text and uppercase labels.
High-contrast black and white base palette, with vibrant, saturated accent colors introduced primarily through full-bleed embedded media and graphic elements.
The hero video/image scales down and parallaxes as the user scrolls, eventually disappearing to reveal the main content. Content sections subtly slide or fade into view as they enter the viewport.
The header navigation 'A/' logo and menu items shrink slightly and stick to the top of the viewport after initial scroll.
Content sections are separated by significant vertical whitespace, creating a very airy and uncluttered feel, with clear visual breaks.

technique_notes: Implement a full-bleed hero video that scales down and applies a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, eventually transitioning out of view.
Create a sticky header that dynamically shrinks its height and font size after a certain scroll threshold, maintaining a minimal presence at the top of the page.
Utilize a smooth scrolling library (like locomotive-scroll) to orchestrate scroll-triggered animations, revealing content blocks with a subtle slide-up or fade-in effect as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, lighter body text and very small, uppercase labels for navigation and categories.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very generous vertical spacing between sections and large margins around text blocks, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its cinematic, full-bleed video hero that dynamically scales and parallaxes on scroll, combined with a stark, high-contrast black-and-white UI. This creates a sophisticated, almost editorial feel that prioritizes visual impact and a smooth, engaging scroll experience over dense information display.
